```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
```

### A

```{r constants}
a <- read.csv("../../data/stockData.csv", check.names = FALSE)
a$Date <- as.Date(a$Date)
a <- a[a$Date >= as.Date("2018-01-01") &
         a$Date < as.Date("2023-01-01"), ]
stocks <- setdiff(names(a), c("Date", "^GSPC"))
tickers <- c("^GSPC", stocks)
prices <- as.matrix(a[, tickers])
r <- prices[-1, ] / prices[-nrow(prices), ] - 1
means <- colMeans(r)
covmat <- cov(r)
mu <- means[stocks]
Sigma <- covmat[stocks, stocks]

one <- rep(1, 30)
u <- solve(Sigma, mu)
v <- solve(Sigma, one)
A <- sum(u)
B <- sum(mu * u)
C <- sum(v)
D <- B * C - A^2
kable(data.frame(A, B, C, D), digits = 4)
```

### B

```{r multipliers}
E <- 0.015
# Merton's convention: minimize (1/2) w' Sigma w.
lambda1 <- (C * E - A) / D
lambda2 <- (B - A * E) / D
kable(data.frame(E, A_over_C = A / C, lambda1, lambda2), digits = 6)
```

### C

```{r target-portfolio}
w_E <- lambda1 * u + lambda2 * v
mean_E <- sum(w_E * mu)
sd_E <- sqrt(drop(t(w_E) %*% Sigma %*% w_E))
kable(data.frame(Stock = stocks, Weight = w_E),
      digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
kable(data.frame(Mean = mean_E, SD = sd_E), digits = 4)
```

### D

```{r parabola}
E_grid <- seq(-0.01, 0.04, length.out = 500)
frontier <- data.frame(
  Mean = E_grid,
  Variance = (C * E_grid^2 - 2 * A * E_grid + B) / D
)
p_d <- ggplot(frontier, aes(x = Variance, y = Mean)) +
  geom_path() +
  labs(x = "Monthly variance", y = "Mean monthly return") +
  theme_minimal()
p_d
```

### E

```{r hyperbola}
sd_grid <- seq(sqrt(1 / C), 1.05 * max(sqrt(diag(covmat))),
               length.out = 500)
offset <- sqrt((D / C) * pmax(sd_grid^2 - 1 / C, 0))
hyperbola <- data.frame(
  SD = rep(sd_grid, 2),
  Mean = c(A / C + offset, A / C - offset),
  Branch = rep(c("Efficient", "Inefficient"), each = 500)
)
p_e <- ggplot(hyperbola, aes(x = 100 * SD, y = 100 * Mean)) +
  geom_path(aes(linetype = Branch)) +
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c(Efficient = "solid",
                                  Inefficient = "dashed")) +
  labs(x = "Monthly standard deviation (%)",
       y = "Mean monthly return (%)", linetype = "Frontier") +
  theme_minimal()
p_e
```

### F

```{r assets-and-portfolios}
w_equal <- rep(1 / 30, 30)
w_min <- v / C
portfolios <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("Equal allocation", "Minimum risk", "Target E"),
  Mean = c(sum(w_equal * mu), sum(w_min * mu), mean_E),
  SD = c(sqrt(drop(t(w_equal) %*% Sigma %*% w_equal)),
         sqrt(drop(t(w_min) %*% Sigma %*% w_min)), sd_E)
)
assets <- data.frame(Asset = tickers, Mean = means,
                     SD = sqrt(diag(covmat)))
p_f <- p_e +
  geom_point(data = assets) +
  geom_text(data = assets, aes(label = Asset),
            vjust = -0.7, size = 2.5, check_overlap = TRUE) +
  geom_point(data = portfolios, aes(shape = Asset, color = Asset),
             size = 3) +
  labs(shape = "Portfolio", color = "Portfolio") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(-0.5, 2.7)) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
p_f
```

### G

```{r arbitrary-portfolios}
# Equal weights within Technology, Healthcare, and Industrials.
W <- matrix(0, nrow = 30, ncol = 3)
W[1:6, 1] <- 1 / 6
W[7:12, 2] <- 1 / 6
W[19:24, 3] <- 1 / 6
arbitrary <- data.frame(
  Asset = c("P1", "P2", "P3"),
  Mean = drop(t(mu) %*% W),
  SD = sqrt(diag(t(W) %*% Sigma %*% W))
)
kable(arbitrary, digits = 4, row.names = FALSE)
p_f +
  geom_point(data = arbitrary, color = "blue", shape = 15, size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = arbitrary, aes(label = Asset),
            color = "blue", hjust = c(-0.3, 1.3, 1.3),
            vjust = c(-1, 1, 2), size = 3)
```

### H

```{r two-fund-frontier}
E2 <- 0.02
w2 <- ((C * E2 - A) / D) * u + ((B - A * E2) / D) * v
mix_returns <- seq(A / C, max(hyperbola$Mean), length.out = 500)
alpha <- (mix_returns - E2) / (E - E2)
mix_weights <- outer(w_E, alpha) + outer(w2, 1 - alpha)
mix <- data.frame(
  Mean = drop(t(mu) %*% mix_weights),
  SD = sqrt(colSums(mix_weights * (Sigma %*% mix_weights)))
)
p_e +
  geom_path(data = mix, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Two-portfolio frontier (red dashed)")
```

Combining the portfolios with monthly expected returns of 1.5% and 2.0%
reproduces the efficient branch in E.
